answer_1.quote: First, we investigate the free-form question-answering task on the LongBench dataset... then assess the application of injected knowledge to address real-world issues through multiple-choice QA on MMedBench.

answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Here we first report the recall (Zhu and Li, 2023b) for models' outputs against ground-truth answers... In Appendix B.7 we also evaluate F1-score... lexical ROUGE-L and semantic BERTScore... Metrics are computed by lexical exact-matching...
